content:
maya: Quick weekly snapshot — runbook readout for Thu afternoon. Main points: APAC demand climbing, EU constrained by egress caps, US has spare preemptible slots.

maya: Numbers: +18% GPU-hours week-over-week in APAC, EU flat, US -6% (preemptible heavy). See per-cluster notes below. :bar_chart:

sanjay: Can you paste the cluster-level burn? I only have the region rollup.

maya: Sure — quick table from the forecast service (24h rolling):
```
APAC: nrt-gpux (1200h), syd-gpux (950h), sin-gpux (620h)
EU: lon-gpux (1100h), fra-gpux (980h)
US: iad-gpux (400h), sfo-gpux (2200h)
```

devon: Noted. syd-gpux shows memory pressure on 3090 pool — pod OOM events up 3x. Likely from long-context evals.

liam: @devon can you link the sched logs? I saw surge throttles but not OOMs.

devon: pasted: `kubectl logs -n infra scheduler-7021` -> repeated failures around 11:12 and 11:16, stack: allocation timeout -> preemption loop.

maya: Mitigations proposed: 1) Move non-critical evals in APAC to sfo-gpux preemptible burst window (2200h spare). 2) Enable soft-evict on syd-gpux 3090 pool for >12h jobs. 3) Increase EU egress token bucket for lon by +15% for next 48h to clear backlog.

anna: For (1) we need routing rules changed in smart-router. I can flip a canary to route label=noncritical -> sfo-preemptible. ETA ~30m. :gear:

sanjay: Cost check — moving APAC to preemptible saves ~35% unit cost but increases failure rate. For the run this week that tradeoff is fine if we mark jobs retryable.

liam: On EU egress — legal flagged additional locality for a customer yesterday. We need approval for temporary bump. @anna can you get gating ticket?

anna: filing ticket now: INF-4312. tagging @legal and @prod-compliance.

oncall-bot: Incident note: multi-cluster scheduling jitter detected in syd-gpux. Pager suppressed (low). See playbook link: https://internal.playbook/infra/scheduling-jitter

devon: Quick config snippet to enable soft-evict (proposal):
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  softEvictThreshold: "0.85"
  maxJobAgeHours: "12"
```

maya: If no objections, will roll the soft-evict to syd-gpux tonight at 02:00 UTC and enable routing canary for noncritical -> sfo-preemptible now.

sanjay: +1 from me. Track cost delta — if we exceed forecasted savings by >10% revert.

liam: Agree. Also let's add a short-term quota bump for lon-gpux egress but scope to non-sensitive customers only.

anna: INF-4312 created, adding the quota request and a short justification.

maya: Action items:
- anna: route canary + create INF-4312 (in flight)
- devon: prepare soft-evict rollout and smoke test (staging)
- liam: approve limited egress bump with compliance once ticket updated
- sanjay: monitor cost & retry rates, report in tomorrow's AM huddle

maya: I'll post a short follow-up once canary is live. Thanks team :white_check_mark:

liam: Also — flag for next week: evaluate adding a small nrt-gpux spot pool to spread APAC load. Preliminary cost modeling next week.

sanjay: noted.

maya: End of thread — last update once INF-4312 has compliance sign-off or canary completes.
